title: Resolution urging Albany to define consent in the Penal Law
summary: This resolution calls on the New York State Legislature to pass, and the Governor to sign, S.5521/A.1140, which would add a formal definition of consent to the Penal Law. The bill defines consent as freely given, knowledgeable and informed agreement by a person with the capacity to reason. Supporters say a clear definition would help address sexual assault, domestic violence, trafficking and related harms.
